address: 117 Huqian Street, Xizhi District, New Taipei, 221022, Taiwan
bio: Perched on the shore of Jinlong Lake, the room is furnished in a modern Chinese style with round perforated windows and dark wood furniture. The chef, whose career spans over 20 years, excels in vegetarian dishes that cross geographical boundaries, showing Chinese, Japanese, Southeast Asian, Indian and Western influences. Try sweet potato leaves dressed in a silky, nutty sesame peanut sauce and soothing Longan floral tea.
